name: Official injury report delta
description: Count of Out/Doubtful/Questionable by team from the official weekly NFL injury report; compare against opponent's report and against the line.

name: Practice-status trend
description: Change in practice participation (DNP -> Limited -> Full) across the week for key positions (QB, LT, WR1, EDGE).

name: Points for / against and net points
description: PF, PA, NET PTS and per-game values from official standings; rank all 32 teams.

name: Winning percentage & streak
description: PCT and STRK from official standings (e.g., 2026-11-02 snapshot in data/standings-2026-wk8.csv).

name: Offense/defense unit stats
description: Official team passing/rushing/receiving/scoring/downs and defensive equivalents (nfl.com team stats).

name: Player stat leaders & trends
description: Official player stat leaderboards (passing yards, rushing, receiving, ... 2026 leaders in data/player-passing-2026.csv).

name: Next Gen Stats tracking metrics
description: NFL NGS: completion probability, expected rushing yards, win probability, speed, separation, etc. Captured 10x/second, 200+ data points per play, on AWS.

name: Rest / bye / travel context
description: Rest days between games and bye placement from the official schedule and official bye list (2026 byes in data/bye-weeks-2026.csv).

name: Official stat corrections
description: Use only corrected official stats (Elias Sports Bureau / NFL League Office) when grading any stat-based signal.

name: Salary cap & roster moves
description: 2026 salary cap $301.2M per club; roster transactions on official club sites (linked from nfl.com/teams/).

name: Line vs. own model (value)
description: Compare the sportsbook line (official operator pages) against the strategy's own model price. Live line VALUES are dynamic and not snapshotted here — see flagged F02.

name: Line movement / closing line value (CLV)
description: Historical line moves and closing lines are NOT published by any official NFL source. Signal defined but unverifiable from official sources — flagged F01.

name: Weather
description: nfl.com game cards show a weather note for upcoming games (e.g., MNF Nov 2: 'Clear, night'), but there is no structured official NFL weather field per game. Per-game values left blank — flagged F05.

name: Public betting % / 'sharp' indicators
description: Not published by official sources. Excluded from all strategies — flagged F06.
